messages:
incident-bot: Pager — us-east-1b: elevated packet loss on egress path from inference nodes (p95 latency +150ms, error rate ~4%). Auto-mitigation started: traffic circuit-break thresholds lowered.

sara: seeing the alert, how many shards impacted? any customer-facing 5xxs?

miguel: +1. NLB health checks to a subset of g5 instances failing intermittently. Cloud metrics show a spike in retransmits on the AZ egress subnet.

devin: temporarily lowering in-flight concurrency and enabling per-request retry with exponential backoff at the edge. Will route new sessions away from the problematic AZ where possible.

lee: set a KV-cache soft-eviction to avoid KVCACHE thrash. If prefix cache regen is heavy, that will amplify egress. Doing: `curl -X POST /admin/cache/evict?policy=soft` on the canary pool.

ops-bot: ran: `aws ec2 describe-instance-status --filters Name=availability-zone,Values=us-east-1b` — some instance statuses show NetworkInterface warnings; also seeing EFA resets.

miguel: suggests traffic-shift to us-east-1a and us-west-2 for affected routing policy. Can we fail over by AZ preference rather than full region?

devin: yes — update routing policy to prefer healthy AZs for new connections and mark failing AZ as degraded for 15m. Patching rollout in progress: `infractl route update --pref az=us-east-1a --deprioritize us-east-1b`

sara: CS: any customer impact numbers? need to draft notification if >1% of API keys impacted.

tilly-cs: monitoring PUT shows ~3% of total requests returning 502/504s originating from the midwest edge pops (which prefer us-east-1b). Preparing a short message: "Some requests may experience transient failures. We're routing traffic to healthy AZs; no data loss."

devin: also switching model fallback: for latency-sensitive routes we will degrade to a quantized variant (model-v2-q8) to reduce token churn while routing stabilizes. `deploy-tool roll model-v2-q8 --routes affected`

lee: added circuit-break config on the gateway to fail fast after 2 retries to avoid cascading load: `circuit_breaker: {max_retries:2, retry_window_ms:300}`

ops-bot: Completed routing update. Canary traffic (5%) now on us-east-1a and us-west-2; error rate on canary is 0.7%.

miguel: next steps — monitor p95 and KVCACHE miss rate for 10m. If stable, promote 25% then full shift.

sara: assigning oncall handoff: @miguel will stay on for next 30m, @devin take 1h for rollback/cleanup if needed.

tilly-cs: sending customer note at T+15m if errors persist >1% per key.

incident-bot: Incident STEADY: mitigation applied (routing shift + circuit-break + model fallback). Continue monitoring.

devin: final note — we should file a post-incident to track whether NAT gateway egress size or provider-level route flap caused this. I captured traceroutes and tcpdump snippets and uploaded to the incident folder.

miguel: ack. Will keep thread updated if anything regresses.
